name: PIKKO — Yum or Bleah!
pitch: Drag the healthier of two foods to Pikko, a vinyl-toy creature that grimaces and dodges junk: fill his belly with healthy kcal over 40 rounds and discover foods from 24 countries.
community: PIKKO (24 country-bag tokens, pre-launch) with a PASTA pass
access: Free reviewer demo at the play URL: the starter bag and a 5-round trial of every bag need no wallet or tokens. Kids mode (default, chosen on first launch): no promotions; an adult (adult question first) unlocks a bag with ONE active DevFridge lock of at least 5,000,000 PASTA (5000000000000 raw, 6 decimals, aggregation single, any duration, unlockAt in the future) or pays 0.001 SOL for ONE round to the DevFridge vault AXomB2bpJ7F3EFVPQwrwBV4yVE7bazshZaVa64KhGCfE, used to buy and burn PASTA (no refunds; confirmed on-chain before the round starts). Grown-ups mode (adult question): every bag is open, with an OnlyFridge Club promotion before each round and a sponsored-token / YOUR AD HERE card; neither ever appears in Kids mode, the tutorial or an unlocked/paid round. PASTA mint 39kMeX4HVRW9qbbiHSPbRQ9xeXUF18GrNP6gL61Ppump (Token-2022, no mint or freeze authority, read-only RPC check 2026-10-04), program 9RY54dNPYTzDyh3TfFqDdt2b2KMM56KW1tw9erRTGQo6. Lock evidence older than 90 s or malformed means unavailable, never unlocked. Wallets: Wallet Standard extensions, Phantom in-app browser, Mobile Wallet Adapter on Android Chrome (Seeker). Locks are only read: the one transaction the game asks a wallet to sign is the optional 0.001 SOL payment, approved in the wallet. Locking and redeeming happen on DevFridge: no early withdrawal, 2% redemption fee buys and burns PASTA, plus network costs; other tokens need a Jupiter route. Browser-side checks only: no server authentication, content not protected.
limitations: No recorded gameplay video: demoUrl is the live free game (first Play opens a tutorial). Scores and the recipe book are local; no server, ranking, rewards or anti-cheat. Verified: 124 unit tests (access boundaries, wallet discovery/connect, sponsor feed validation and adapter, payment confirmation with fake RPC and wallet), type check, build, scripted Chrome playthroughs, mock-wallet and mock-DevFridge access flows, Seeker-sized emulation, the 0.001 SOL transfer bytes accepted by a read-only mainnet simulation, and the Android app art.pikko.game (a Trusted Web Activity of pikko.art/play) installed and played on a physical Seeker. NOT verified: any real 0.001 SOL payment (wallet prompt and on-chain read-back), the vault's internals (owner-stated, read-only on-chain look only), a sponsor card with a real boost (the live feed was empty), the final Android build's wallet round trip, a real lock or redemption, Safari/Firefox, a nutritionist review. MWA works only in Chrome. 17 of 20 languages are machine translations; audio cues are owner-generated candidates with commercial terms still to confirm. AI-built with Claude Code (BUILD_LOG.md).
